workspace.description: The workspace to list, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

repository.description: The repository, by its full name (owner/name), as list_repositories lists it.

path.description: The file's path from the repository's root, such as src/index.ts.

firstLine.description: The first line to read, from 1; 1 where left out.

commit.description: The commit to read the file at, by its full SHA; the default branch's head where left out.
